status: Concept H01; article dimensions, fits, forces and thermal performance unqualified

module_pitch.description: Separation of the two demonstration docks

tube_radius.description: Illustrative external body radius; not a manufacturer fit

radial_clearance.description: Nominal radial cavity clearance; must be tested on real tubes

collar_z.description: Underside of collar and upper insert seat

transfer_travel.description: Illustrative outward slide along negative Y

latch_travel.description: Illustrative latch retraction along positive X

grip_pad_z.description: Bottom of common external grip pads

interfaces.note: These are common concept interfaces for the two variants, not measured tube dimensions or an industry standard

handoff_sequence: Confirm lid closed and tube retained in carrier
Reserve dock; inhibit lid mechanism and retract dock latch
Approach from front while holding carrier grip pads
Confirm carrier seated, tube present and hinge orientation correct
Close latch and independently confirm retention before sender releases
Confirm receiver grasp before retracting latch and withdrawing carrier
limitations: Both tube shapes and cap/hinge envelopes are illustrative, not manufacturer CAD and not volume-accurate containers; rounded bottom is a six-segment revolved profile
Collar clips, hinge key and latch are contact/mechanism envelopes; no compliant mechanism, actuator or sensor is selected
Metal insert bottom is coplanar with dock floor as a proposed heat path; thermal contact and sample temperature are unverified
First prototype is manually loaded outside the lid station; loose-tube rack loading is a separate task
H01 is a separate demonstration dock, not an integrated replacement for the C01 cold insert
The gripper is a space envelope with nominal clearance, not a selected gripper or a validated grasp
Motion checks cover sampled slider poses, not full robot trajectories, swept volumes or physical safety
